description:
Replace the body or the files of a reply draft in status draft. This does not send email. Send html, text or attachments; without html and text the body stays. The new body replaces the old one: html alone derives the text part, text alone makes a plain-text draft. Recipients, subject and reply headers stay derived from the source message, and the draft ID stays the same. Returns a conflict when the draft is not in status draft, when the thread changed since its expected_version (the draft becomes invalidated: read the thread again and create a new draft), when the draft changed concurrently, or when it belongs to the Shipmail Assistant. Supported HTML: p, br, strong/b, em/i, u, s, a (http, https, mailto, tel), ul, ol, li, blockquote, code, pre, h2, h3, span/mark with the composer's styles, and inline cid: images. h1 becomes h2. Tables and h4-h6 are not supported: their text stays as paragraphs and removed_formatting lists them ('table' for any table part, 'h4', ...), as it lists other dropped elements such as script, style or iframe. Attributes and inline styles outside the composer set are dropped and not reported. Paragraphs are already spaced like the Shipmail composer, so do not add


between them. When html is given without text, the text part is derived from it.

attachments.description: Replaces the draft's files, in this order: { id } keeps a current file (ids from the latest draft read), { staged_attachment_id } adds an upload from shipmail_prepare_staged_attachment_upload. [] removes them all; leave it out to keep them. At most 20 files and 25 MB in total.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.

name: shipmail_update_inbox_reply_draft

id.description: Names the file in the stored draft as it is now. It changes after every update; read the draft again for current ids.

content_sha256.description: Hash of the complete canonical subject/text/HTML snapshot. Null when unavailable.

conversation_id.description: Stable Shipmail conversation ID. thread_id is deprecated.

html.description: Stored HTML after sanitisation. Null once the stored draft no longer exists.

removed_formatting.description: Formatting the HTML sanitiser dropped: 'table' for any table part, 'h4' to 'h6', and other dropped elements such as 'script'. Their text stays as paragraphs.

review_url.description: Link for a person to review this one draft and send it, or null when the draft is not in draft status or the key is in test mode. The person must be signed in with access to the mailbox. Opening it sends nothing, and it stops working after the send.

text.description: Stored text part. Null once the stored draft no longer exists.

thread_id.description: Deprecated mail-server thread ID. Unchanged and still supported; conversation_id is the stable identifier.

to.description: Empty, like cc, once the stored draft no longer exists (after a send or cleanup).

title: Update Inbox Reply Draft
